cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've kept every ticket from our trips. Loose tickets deteriorate, so I've filed them by date. Where are yours?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Glued into the album I made you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Glued in? Oh, love. The adhesive ruins them. I'll scan each page; fortunately one of us thought about preserving our memories.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already scanned it. That's why I could give you the only album.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send me the files, please. Not screenshots, the originals. I'll make a backup so your lovely gesture survives.

reason: B2 now explicitly establishes the glue before A3 criticizes it; preserve the album, scan and backup progression.
